title: Coefficient square on the named raw chart groups
statement: Construct the cohomology square of coefficient endomorphisms on the raw chart groups. Its map is normalizationCohomologyRestriction, its actions are the explicitly named normalizationCohomologyAction maps, and its law follows from the coefficient square under inverse-image composition. Prove the explicit single-complex formula for each named action.

source.place: Tag 03Q8, lemma-higher-direct-images, restriction of cohomology classes; Descent Tag 03DR, tensor-section restriction.

proof.text: Define each chart action by cohomology of Q of the single-complex coefficient endomorphism; its formula is reflexivity. Instantiate coefficientCohomologySquare with the single-complex functors, Q/cohomology functors, prescribed raw-pullback transformation and inverse-image coefficient comparison. Supply the proved raw component formula and the assumed coefficient square. The resulting explicit data are normalization restriction and the named chart actions, with the record formulas and commutation law.
